scope: Exploratory temporal receptive-field comparison against completed cartesian_overfit/mixed_eight, paired by seed, source RNG, examples, optimizer and steps. Only temporal dilation changes; parameters and spatial receptive field unchanged. Theoretical per-evaluation temporal span 341 instead of 17 frames, not a guarantee of effective long-range learning. Compare time-resolved connected temporal correlations at lags 1,2,4,8,16,32, spatial correlations and magnetization variance; report all seeds and checkpoints without selecting the best. Three training seeds are robustness checks, not a powered population inference. Selected eight training paths are not a physical probability reference. No production promotion or size-transfer claim.
